observations: Photo 0 shows a black mid-back office chair with a mesh backrest, padded seat, and chrome five-star base with black casters.
The armrests are curved, black, and appear to be made of plastic or coated metal.
The seat fabric has some visible dust or debris, and the mesh back has a pattern of horizontal slats and vertical supports.
Photo 1 shows the back of the chair, revealing a solid plastic back panel with horizontal slats and a mesh insert in the center.
The base is chrome and appears intact, with all five casters visible and seemingly functional.
No brand or model markings are visible on the chair in either photo.
The chair is photographed on a concrete floor, with a dark cabinet or desk in the background.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'EJUWEHWE EDWIN' are overlaid on both photos.
